limitations: Fixed accepted R06 native person. This diagnosis is not an R07 product or an anatomical thickness measurement.
Read actual original indexed geometry and semantic arrays. Native and drawn surfaces are labelled separately; no prefix correspondence is presumed.
Temporary no-bump/albedo shader windows freeze an already evaluated surface. No pose/update or R06 compatibility report is called while temporary hooks are attached.
The complete native state, evaluated geometry, inputs, material parameters, uniform objects/values, camera/light, solver call counts and original compiled shader/pixels must restore exactly.
Each material window saves baseline, no-bump, albedo, restored-original frames. Neutral/pucker are original baseline observations only.
No volume, physiological validity, continuous animation, cross-person or device performance acceptance follows from this diagnostic.

innerReport.semanticDomain: clamp(l19State.x,0,1) * skin coverage * native lip enable; continuous interpolation
innerReport.comparisonGeometryCondition: matched r04/r02 switches while already using R02 base; returning from legacy R07 first restores inherited R02 relief

calibration.method: Fixed native jaw=.36 before-local surface and distances to the original upper/lower contact polylines
calibration.protectedBodyRule: All v>=-.015 or csType>=.5 remain exactly outside the correction

solver.correction: Add only the change in upper/lower tissue ownership to opposing local direction terms and closure sign
solver.invalidation: Supported identity/shape/calibration/topology edits disable this correction and continue original evaluation; enabling it again requires deterministic jaw=.36 reinstall
limitations: Reference carrier ownership is a geometric construction, not measured tissue anatomy.
The existing gap interpolation, collision scope, strain model and original pressure fields are retained.
Actual candidate images, dynamic midpoint continuity, archives and cross-person use still require independent verification.

binding.method: Screened positive rest-graph redistribution of the complete native pucker increment using the identical matrix for x, up and front, with fixed core and exterior boundary values
binding.coreRule: Union of native top.lips, all samples.rim, original pairs, and native roi with abs(u)<=1 and 0<=v<=1.05; plus exactly one full-index neighbour ring. Negative-v and oral points are ineligible for edits.
binding.exteriorRule: Same-side native type<.5, inner<=.005, v>=0, front>.25, depth<6mm; native exterior vertical region; free points exclude core and abs(u)<=.64
binding.fades: Coefficient g: u .64-.84 and 1.5-1.6; front .25-.75; depth 3.5-6mm; 1mm outer vertical fades. Domain is not cut 4mm from the lip core.

solver.method: Diagonal-preconditioned conjugate gradients on the symmetric positive-definite correction system; actual residual recomputed

binding.sourceValues: Current before-local native pucker difference relative to pucker=0 with every other local action held fixed; x/up/front use one identical matrix; zero for originally inactive vertices; no posed displacement stored at install

linearSolve.residualDefinition: Each component uses the same SPD matrix; aggregate maxima are not a global vector solution-error bound. Full actual scalar residuals remain separately reported.

x.residualDefinition: max abs(A*correction-rhs)/diagonal in mm; relative Euclidean residual also required; both recomputed after bounds check

up.residualDefinition: max abs(A*correction-rhs)/diagonal in mm; relative Euclidean residual also required; both recomputed after bounds check

front.residualDefinition: max abs(A*correction-rhs)/diagonal in mm; relative Euclidean residual also required; both recomputed after bounds check

sourceAgreement.toleranceRule: Per display coordinate: one Float32 ULP at max(abs(before),abs(predictedFinal)) plus 64*Number.EPSILON*(abs(before)+abs(predictedIncrement)+1), all in native metres; require every normalized coordinate error<=1
sourceAgreement.location: Actual original local plus R05 local ownership boundary, before any R06 correction or closure; compare actual position-minus-base with the predicted complete pucker increment

solver.component: The complete native pucker difference relative to pucker=0 is redistributed in mouth-frame x/up/front using one identical matrix; every other local action is held fixed
solver.protectedDomains: Native rail body, vermilion, rim, original contact samples and one-ring collar; center abs(native u)<=.64; oral and negative-v excluded
solver.puckerZero: Direct original R05 evaluation without nested R06 hooks or position writes
limitations: Four millimetres is an engineering smoothing length, not a physical tissue measurement or a hard support cutoff.
The rail-body/core mask is a conservative construction from native fields, not measured tissue anatomy; downstream final contact equality still requires actual verification.
The original pucker transverse compensation formula is retained in the source difference but its peripheral increment is redistributed; its physiological validity is not established.
Actual source agreement is available only for pure-pucker local actions with tissueDepth=1; mixed-action integration is not claimed as externally validated.
The original closure, pressure, contact scope, static shape and every non-pucker motion contribution remain unchanged.
Unsupported historical or custom material states disable this candidate without changing those states or their labels.

coordinateFrame.source: Original ao(model) landmark frame, canonical [x,y,z] converted to native geometry [x,z,-y]
coordinateFrame.units: Native position units; source convention metres, differences multiplied by 1000 for mm

lastCompleted.beforeStage: R05 closure correction completed; Kd constructed; dental projection loop has not processed its first vertex
lastCompleted.afterStage: Natural iterator exhaustion after dental projection loop; before its first computeVertexNormals and subsequent microgeometry
lastCompleted.normalStatus: Normal buffer is intentionally not sampled as a new normal solution at these boundaries

lowerCurrentFrame.classification: Pre-projection edge midpoint in the current native mouth frame; abs(mean native u)<.7 and signed up<0. This is a pose-space half-space, not physiological ownership.

upperCurrentFrame.classification: Pre-projection edge midpoint in the current native mouth frame; abs(mean native u)<.7 and signed up>=0. This is a pose-space half-space, not physiological ownership.

lastCompleted.interpretation: Measured position response of this native loop only. A neighboring displacement difference is not tissue thickness, contact correctness, self-intersection or a visual-quality score.

edgeInventory.source: Every edge of original topology.geometry.index, deduplicated by actual endpoint IDs; not top.neighbors
edgeInventory.reportingScope: Cross-v=.05 edges with at least one endpoint in original top.lips; both endpoint types/semantics retained. Ranked by measured forward-delta difference.

envelopeProbeRestore.wrapperIdentityScope: Exact retained outer R06 solver.apply function/descriptor and public R05/R06 API identities; inner R05 closure function is private. Its actual calls and last completed/hooksRestored reports are checked after unwind.
limitations: Stages after iterator exhaustion (normal rebuild, microgeometry, final normals) are not included in this delta.
Positions and edges use native topology IDs; no native-to-draw prefix mapping is assumed.
No thickness, collision correctness, anatomy, causal visual diagnosis or acceptance follows from these measurements.
